entities.name: Mirko Kovač
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mirko Kovač is a Serbian professional basketball player who last played for Kumanovo of the Macedonian First League. He was a member of the Serbian cadet and junior national team. He won cadet European Championship '99. He was 3rd MVP Serbian League and best 3 points shooter 2006. Best 3 points shooter in Romanian League 2014.
